56002.description: The medical treatment costs 10 million yen? If she can't pay it, she has to sell herself?? Akari happens to injure Hiro, a successor to the family of a financial combine. Now she has to take care of him day and night. She is told to do this and that...an unbelievable order!?

56003.description:
Aina ends up being late for school one day because she was having sex with her boyfriend, Fujioka. As punishment, the student council president, Nojima, tasks her with cleaning duty. Aina is cleaning out the equipment room when Fujioka sneaks up behind her. Thinking that they'll get a chance to resume their morning activities, they hear a sound outside and have to hide...

(Source: BakaBT)

Note: Published in Comic Megastore H 2006-01

56004.description: His chief is a very strict woman, but when they are left alone working overtime, they can do whatever they want as a couple.

56006.description:
Ten years before Sora fought to save the worlds, three young Keyblade wielders named Terra, Aqua, and Ventus trained in the hopes of becoming Masters one day. But everything changed on the day of Terra and Aqua's Mark of Mastery exam, and the three each set off on their own journeys that would test their friendship-and alter the course of their destinies forever.

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: キングダムハーツバースバイスリープ

56008.description: Story of the four brothers of the Akatsuki family, and how they found their boyfriends.

56010.description:
If you at look the earth from one light year ahead, you can see the earth from a year before. Beyond 10 light years will be 10 years before, beyond 100 light years will be 100 years. ...it's like a universe is a big time machine.

In a village where you can see stars clearly, villagers will forced to leave the town in a year, because of new strange power plant will be build. when they realize it, there were weird bars being builded surrounding the village, seem like it will swallowed the town real soon. In the village where Koutarou grows up on for 11 years, Koutarou didn't want to accept the fact that village will be disappeared. Koutarou is so determined to save the village, and it was a beginning of summer break. in front of Kotarou and Haruhiko (his best friend), Oosaki Kanna, woman who suit a smile arrived to town. This encounter was the beginning of an unforgettable summer...

title.native: ロゼッタからの招待状

56011.description: Follows the journey of a detective looking for a man who went by the name of "Mister Bo."

title.native: ミスター・ボージャングル

56012.description:
Rather more representative of the Nishioka siblings' writing style than Kami no Kodomo, this is a collection of quietly philosophical one-shots that explore the thoughts and feelings of ordinary people in an odd, surrealistic manner replete with atypical and symbolic illustrations.

1) Kokoro ga Kowareta (心が壊れた, A Broken Soul); AX Vol.22
2) Boku no Kodomo-tachi ni (ぼくの子供たちに, To My Children); Vol.3
3) Kokoro no Kanashimi (心の悲しみ, Sadness of the Heart); Vol.6
4) Kekkonshiki (結婚式, Wedding); Vol.11
5) Sora wo Tobu (空を飛ぶ, Flying); Vol.15
6) Hebi Onna (蛇女, Snake Woman); Vol.16
7) Shinigami (死神, God of Death); Vol.17
8) Watashi no Yuurei (わたしの幽霊, My Ghost); Vol.19
9) Me no Aru Ikimono (目のある生き物, A Creature with Eyes); Vol.23
10) Tsurishi no Nayami (釣り師の悩み, An Angler's Anguish); Vol.21
11) Kanashii Koi no Hanashi (悲しい恋の話し, Sad Love Story)
12) Jinsei Iroiro (人生いろいろ, Life Has Its Ups and Downs); Vol.18

56013.description:
Can you choose who you love more when it's between two girls?

Note: 4 Pages Short One-shot Published in Comic Doki! 2007-01

56017.description:
A collection of stories:

1. Dakishimete Kureru Nara (抱きしめてくれるなら)
2. Rojiura no Sea (路地裏のシイ); b-BOY Vol. 27
3. Cherry Red no Kokoro (チェリーレッドの心);

title.native: 抱きしめてくれるなら

56018.description:
Love-affairs between the members of an army team, the Seal. The main characters are Jim and Roy, of whom Roy is the captain of the team. Although he acts quite tough, inside he is very weak and suffers from several bad experiences in his past.
Then there is also the young Cyril (?) who happens to be very self-destructive. The series is at time very explicit, but deals with themes like sexual abuse and rape in a sensitive way.

56021.description:
11-year old Niina is special. This is because she has the memories of her past life as a girl named Chitose still intact. Among these memories is a promise with Chitose's boyfriend which Niina then decides to try and fulfill. But can she really?

(Source: Shoujo-Crusade)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Koi Baka.
Volume 4: Yasashii Tenohira, Machibito

56023.description:
Yakuza Cafe is about an innocent young man who, after the death of the grandmother who raised him, is sent to an address where he finds a unique cafe.

(Source: Anime News Network)

56024.description: Classmates from middle school, Oogoshi and Saotome reunite at their job. Oogashi is as popular and talented as he was in middle school. For long, Saotome has held on tight to his admiration but now that they're both adults he can't really tell him that easily. What will Oogashi say when he it seems like he's seen right through his feelings!? A youthful love story of two awkward salary men!
synonyms: Get Wet in the Spring Rain

title.romaji: Haru no Ame ni Nurete Yuke

56026.description:
A boy returns to his family home in the country and strikes up an odd friendship with the young girl who lives next door, Sora, who believes the boy is God. However, it is Plato, the boy's pet turtle, with whom Sora develops a strong bond. Plato believes Sora to be the classical Greek philosopher Socrates and calls her his teacher. Together, they ponder the mysteries and wonders of life in the quiet but beautiful countryside.

(Source: Lucia Rose)
synonyms: すみっこの空さん Petite philosophie

56032.description:
It's a single volume with a short series and some one-shots by Izayoi Seishin and written by Yamasaki Masato

(Source: Tadanohito)

56034.description:
It is 199X A.D. In Kushiro, Hokkaido, three bodies of Dragonite appear. Possessing overwhelming destructive force, they attack the city. They also awaken the evil Jashin Drago from the holy seal he was trapped in. 200 years ago, Drago was trapped in the seal by a holy warrior with the tattooed mark of the Liger. Assuming that the warrior is dead, Drago and Empress Zara are free to conquer the Earth using their army of biomechanical beasts. Even the Japan Self-Defense Forces are no match for the Dragonites' awesome power. One of the people fleeing is the protagonist, a milquetoast 16 year old boy named Ken Taiga. Unbeknownst to the Dragonites, Ken realizes that he is the descendant of the Liger warrior. In a burst of anger, Ken's Liger birthmark appears, and he rises his palm into the air, shouting the henshin command, "LIGER!" which then covers him in demonic, long-haired biomechanical armor. Ken transforms into Jushin Liger to fight the evil forces of the Dragonite!

(Source: Wikipedia)

56035.description:
Shuu and Yuuki are cousins. Shuu believes that Yuuki is a boy based on behavior and looks but for some unknown reason to him, he is sexually attracted to Yuuki. Concerned that he might be sexually attracted to boys, Shuu decides to ask Yuuki directly...

(Source: BakaBT)

Note: Published in Comic Hotmilk 2009-10.

56036.description:
Alice has just transferred to a school in Japan from England, and a whole world of adventures await with her new friends Shinobu, Aya, Karen, and Youko. Join the girls' daily school lives as they learn more about Japan's language and culture!

(Source: Yen Press)

56041.description: The kick-off chapter of the Official Sora no Otoshimono spin-off 4 panel manga. The story revolves around the three Angeloids naming Astrea, Ikaros & Nymph and how they go about their not so ordinary life on earth.

56042.description:
Two students get caught cheating on a test and are sent to clean the pool after school as punishment...

(Source: BakaBT)

title.native: カラのプールでエキサイト！！

56043.description:
This is a collection of short stories and one-shots.

(Source: BakaBT)

56045.description: This manga is about life of Alexander Anderson before he become a member of Iscariot. He is a mafia assassin tried to escape from the police after betraying the organization he worked with. To trick his pursuers, he dressed up as a priest and hid himself in a village. But organization found the church he worked. Threatening Anderson with killing the nun in the church, organization menber Flanders demanded the return of the stolen "goods" - 50 kilo of heroin. Instead of return debts he defeat Flanders and his crew, and rescued the nun. Now the two of them are fleeing from the organization...

56046.description:
One rainy day, Yuta Yoshizawa is working at his family's senbei shop when a member of his old high school club, Shizuno, appears. Even though they are merely acquaintances, Shizuno begins visiting the shop every few days, which rekindles Yuta’s secret interest that has been smoldering since high school. The sweetest, sexiest, and most heartwarming story is here! We also present to you a love story that spans 20 years between Shoichi, Yuta’s dependable older brother, and his wild childhood friend, Seigo.

(Source: DMG)

56048.description:
This is all about a 16-year old guy named Gan(family name: Goda) who, along with his various fighting -video-game-styled pals, opposes the very naughty Hanged Cross gang on an alarmingly regular basis.

As the story begins, Gan is a juvenile delinquent who has been booted out of one too many schools for chronic bad behavior. Gan's father, a hotdog supercop with the moniker of "Dan Goda," is fed up with this situation to the point where he decides to send Gan to his old educational institution: a fighting school called Roujuu Private High School. There, Gan learns to harness his raw abilities into "Gunfighting," the family martial arts style resembling firearms. Think .44 Magnum punches, Shotgun Fists, Sniper Stances, and you've got the essence of Gun-Fu down.

At his new school Gan also falls madly in love hot chick, Yuki and runs afoul of 17-year old transfer student and sure-to-be-rival Garrick Rider, prodigal master of the Hanged Cross technique. Fights over Yuki's affections take place in the school stadium, but it turns that she has little need for defenders of her honor. Yuki is, like an overwhelming majority of students at Roujuu, a fantastic fighter. And from here on out, everbody is not only "kung-fu fighting," but also busy filling pages with over-the-top battle scenes.

56051.description: After watching a certain television program, Hirona suddenly decided to start a "Detective Group", forcibly making her chilhood friend Mio as group member 1 and a just happen to pass by Fuuka as group member 2. With Fuuka inviting her friend Megumi as group member 3 thus begins their adventure... or not. A slice of life manga following the peaceful if eccentric life of main character Nakamura Hirona, Hikawa Mio, Yamamoto Fuuka, and Sawaki Megumi.

56054.description: The first half is about a school where a group of boys train their teacher and eventually the student council to become sex slaves. Then there is a one shot about an incestuous family including a futa mother and daughter. Then two more chapters about an exhibitionist who is caught in the bathroom by a peeping tom.

56055.description: After his sister's death, Ryousuke's parents separate. Feeling utterly helpless, Ryousuke runs away from home and finds himself on the other side of the rainbow in Nijigahara, a place where time doesn't flow and everybody is a child. But, will Ryousuke's presence in this seeming utopia, bring the fantasy world to an end and will Ryousuke ever get back home?

title.english: The Other Side of the Rainbow

56060.description:
There once was a monster called Karma who loved to challenge his victims to a battle of wits. If the subject succeeded, the monster would grant them one wish, but if they lost, he would devour their soul. At the same time, there was a young monk called Hanasaku Ikkyuu, who was famed for his cleverness. He used to eagerly sharpen his mind, solving challenging riddles sent to him, until his mother fell ill. When he found that his cleverness was of no use in helping her, he gave it up.

Karma seeks out Ikkyuu, eager to bet him in a battle of wits and consume his soul. One day, Ikkyuu rescued a young beggar boy, only to see him fall ill with a mysterious illness. That same day, Karma finally finds Ikkyuu and offers him his dangerous bargain. Thanks to Karma, will Ikkyuu finally have a way to use his cleverness to help the people around him?

(Source: MangaHelpers)

56062.description:
1. Aki (アキ)
2. Real Ranger (リアルレンジャー)
3. Sensei Datte Onnanoko (先生だって女の子)
4. King Club (キングクラブ)
5.King Club Yuumugi Otoko Hen (キングクラブ 友無技男 編)

title.native: Hな楽園~美少女交姦日記~
title.romaji: H na Rakuen: Bishoujo Koukan Nikki

56068.description:
A collection of short stories:

1. Love
2. Research
3. Mistaken Identity
4. Womb Noises
5. Restraint
6. Poisoning
7. Duty
8. Capture
9. Courtship

56069.description: A rumor is floating around among musicians, about a groupie named Luna that can make you famous if you have sex with her. Is the rumor true or not? And who exactly is this Luna?

56070.description: About a wife who is left alone by her busy husband and son to take care of her dog.  Contains bestiality.

56079.description:
Kazusa is an adult (who looks just like a middle-schooler) that is coincidentally the new health teacher of the primarily female Wakabane Middle School! He knows everything about how the female body works, so just what lies in stock for our supposedly not-perverted heroine?!

(Source: Kirei Cake)

56081.description:
Aisupe @ is a love comedy story based on the online game "ai sp@ce" that features cosplaying using various heroines from popular games and shows such as D.C. II, CLANNAD, and SHUFFLE! as references!

(Source: Kirei Cake)

56085.description:
OreKou follows the story of the light novels, set at the time when Kirino Kousaka leaves for America to undergo athletic training. While the OreImo anime series tells the story in Kirino's elder brother Kyousuke's point of view, OreKou focuses on Kuroneko's experiences as Ruri Gokou, a high school freshman who becomes Kyousuke's junior. While Kuroneko struggles in mingling with her new classmates, she tries to sort out her feelings for Kyousuke.

(Source: OreImo Wikia)

Note: Chapter count includes a Chapter Zero prologue and four additional bonus chapters.
synonyms: My Underclassmen Can't Be This Cute
Ore no Kohai ga Konna ni Kawaii Wake ga Nai

title.native: 俺の後輩がこんなに可愛いわけがない
title.romaji: Ore no Kouhai ga Konna ni Kawaii Wake ga Nai

56088.description: Police officer Tsuchida gets his face slapped by the delinquent Haruki while questioning him. Since that night, Tsuchida keeps thinking about how cool and passionate Haruki looked.

56089.description:
An electrician called to a remote job deep in the mountains discovers the startling reasons behind the behavior of the house's lone occupant, an eccentric young sculptor.

(Source: SuBLime)

title.english: The Bed of My Dear King

56090.description: Magane seems like an ordinary boy until the day that he realizes that he can make a sword out of his own shadow. However, he must be careful about using the sword too often, or his shadow will swallow him. There are other people with this ability, and opposing them is a group of people marked with an ominous seal, who are able to wield swords of light. Will Magane be able to figure out what's going on, and use his power responsibly? (from mangaupdates.com)

title.native: アルカイック・チェイン

56091.description: Shiina is a serious man who has wanted to be a zoology professor since he was a child.  He was infamous for always carrying around many massive books and now Shiina works diligently to train future zoologists at a university while looking after his childfood friend, Chitose.  Chitose is also an associate professor of biology and walks around everywhere with penguins, making him quite infamous. This manga focuses on the trials, tribulations, and future of the young associate professor, Shiina.

56093.description: She competes with him....If she loses, he can violate her.

56096.description: At her new job as a bunny girl she has to put up with whatever the male guests want to do to her.

title.native: 美尻! 巨乳♪美少女♥とあるカジノのバ二ーガール
title.romaji: Bijiri! Kyonyuu♪Bishoujo♥Toaru Casino no Bunny Girl

56099.description: Ririko, a stylish Charisma Gal from Shibuya, finds herself playing amateur detective after an unexpected turn of events. She is keen to solve cases to prove herself worthy of elite police detective Nii, a man she adores and regards as her fiance. But her enthusiasm leads her into a whole lot of trouble.

56103.description: Two light novels written by Ichiro Okouchi with illustrations by Chiho Saito, "Shoujo Kakumei Utena: Ao no Soujyu" and "Shoujo Kakumei Utena: Midori no Omoi" expand on material from the television series, with Ao no Soujyu focusing on the first five episodes of the series and Midori no Omoi focusing on Wakaba's Black Rose character arc.
synonyms: Shoujo Kakumei Utena: Midori no Omoi

title.native: 少女革命ウテナ -蒼の双樹-
title.romaji: Shoujo Kakumei Utena: Ao no Soujyu

56104.description:
Noriko is caught up in an accident while she is going to her track and field competition. When she opens her eyes, there is the young doctor Shinoda who seems very concerned about her. She is attracted to his child-like smile, but from his lips, she learns a shocking truth - in the accident, Noriko has lost her physical body and what remains is only a brain, stuck in a little black box?!

Note: The side stories in volume 1, 2 & 3 are written in novel format.

56105.description: Time passes and life goes on as always for Tsubaki, Hirawa, and the little Fumio, who is now in elementary school.

56106.description:
Miyaji Rintaro is a normal salary man who visits the foreign country of Gladimar to seal a business contract to export a rare plant called Kapalu. Even with the contract signed and sealed, everything isn’t as it seems as Rintaro finds a beautiful chained girl who suddenly attacks him. Is there something more to this country and the Kapalu plant than meets the eye?

(Source: Aerandria)

title.native: スーツの国の魔法使い

synonyms: I gotta believe Ore Nara Dekiru sa

title.native: アイガッタベリーブ！　～俺ならできるさ～
title.romaji: I gotta believe! ~Ore Nara Dekiru sa~

56112.description: Today, I'm shopping with Papa... Natsu-chan loves her father very much, and doesn't hesitate to show it. But the line between love and lust seems to blur quickly between them, and her demands are just too impossible for her father to ignore....

56120.description: Taiyou finds a stray kitten on the sidewalk and manages to find an owner for her. Later that night, the kitten comes to visit Taiyou at his apartment to say thanks...

56121.description:
Wakaba has a sealed memory that she cannot recall. The memory came back to her when she meets a new transfer student. It is the memory of "her sweet first love." And that person who loved her was a vampire, with silver hair that shines like moonlight and eyes as red as blood. She knows she must not fall in love with him, but she cannot suppress her feelings of attraction... What will happen to the two of them in this forbidden love affair?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

56123.description: A demon with a riceball-shaped head named Taizo comes to Earth looking for legendary girls with star-shaped nipples.

56125.description:
Midori Makibao is a small white racehorse. Compared to other thoroughbred horses, he looks more like a donkey with wide nostrils. However, with his guts and speed as his weapon, Makibao wins in every big race. In the beginning of his career, Makibao had a trouble making his debut as a racehorse, because of his appearance and various disadvantages he had. But Makibao had reasons to overcome his difficulties; there was a lifelong rival horse called Superhorse Cascade, that Makibao needed to defeat. Plus, he was determined to win back his mother, a horse that had been taken away for pay back the debt on the farm. There are many hardships that Makibao has to overcome, but he thrives in the series of races to become a great racehorse.

Midori no Makibao won the Sogakukan Manga Award for children's manga in 1997.

56131.description: A Prototype of the Rosario+Vampire's first chapter.

title.native: プロトタイプ版 ロザリオとバンパイア

56132.description: Winter 1989, Alaska. Blanca has escaped from a secret training camp in the Soviet bloc, counting only on his instinct to pass the Bering Strait and reach Alaska, the land of wolves. Hounded by the secret services, the genetically altered dog is driven by call of nature and of his land to continue the endless journey, embodying an ancient Inuit legend because of his extraordinary fighting skills, speed and endurance. But in his journey he comes across very dangerous enemies.

56133.description: "not be, but be" is a short manga depicting Ulquiorra Cifer's past only featured in Bleach: Official Character Book 3 UNMASKED.

56138.description:
Yani, the young prime minister of the empire of Pisar, wanted to see his dear childhood friend, the beautiful attorney general, Sesaam purely as a friend. But it seems his heart isn't following his mind. On one hand he's facing the facts that he wants Sesaam as his lover but on another hand he didn't want to destroy the trust he had build for years with Sesaam due to his selfish feelings. Then, all of a sudden, Sesaam told him he could have sex with him...!?

(Source: Bliss)

56140.description:
Couverture, a specialty store run by a pair of handsome brothers dealing in fine chocolates,

For the times when you are swaying in between career and love.
For the times you are troubled awaiting a spring romance.
For the times when you feel like you have forgotten how to smile or be gentle.

If you take one step into the shop, you will understand the flavor of happiness they want to share with everyone.

56142.description: Renji is a photography college student., just now living on his own in Tokyo. He sets about seducing a classmate, and then things start to go in direction he didn’t expect. Thus begins a romantic, comedy, ecchi manga in the style of Ecchi and Desire…
synonyms: You Don't Know What Love Is

56143.description:
A revolutionary and wildly entertaining parenting essay for the new era! The author, who had to juggle between multiple comic serializations, finds herself flustered (= panics and easily agitated) daily as she navigates her first experience in parenting!! Her son, Baby Go, delivers unexpected and unpredictable reactions one after another... You'll definitely get hooked by his dangerously charming pranks!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

Note: Nominated for the 2nd Manga Taishou Award in 2009.

56144.description:
Follows the daily experiences of high school boys.

Note: Includes 26 chapters of "Joshikousei wa Ijou (女子高生は異常)", and six extra chapters.
synonyms: Daily Lives of High School Boys

title.english: The Daily Lives of High School Boys

56146.description:
The series follows the odd life of kindergartner Makoto Sawada and his family. Makoto gets into all sorts of toilet and adult humor. He sometimes dresses in his mother's and sister's clothing, and often has a long strand of mucus dangling from his nose.

Note: Celebrities such as Keisuke Kuwata, Naoko Ken, Momoe Yamaguchi, Iruka and the Bay City Rollers members often appear in the series, and Elvis Presley, who died in 1977 during serialization, is featured as a main character in one episode.

56147.description:
The Sawada family decides to hold a home video contest with the rule that “whoever wins the Grand Prix will be chosen as that year’s protagonist.” They take turns filming with the camera. When it’s finally Makoto’s turn, he has no idea what to film, so he sets his sights on a pile of dog poop in the park, but…

As the sequel to the legendary gag series that took the ’70s by storm, the “Heisei-era” Makoto-chan—serialized in Shonen Sunday starting in 1988—makes a triumphant return! Get ready for a Bichiguso-level shock as Makoto Sawada of the Ume Class at Seishu Kindergarten unleashes a barrage of mind-blowing gags!! Gwash!!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: At the time of serialization, the series' title was Makoto-chan, but it has been retitled in later releases as Chou! Makoto-chan.
synonyms: 平成版　まことちゃん

56149.description:
At an all-girls school during the Taisho era of Japan, rumors swirl that heiress Sayaka Yoshimura is having a forbidden love affair with her chauffeur, Shinobu Narutaki! Sayaka scoffs at the rumors, but could a romance between master and servant actually be brewing?

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Chapter count includes the extras "Ruka to Touzoku" (Luca and the Bandit), "Yonenmae no Chikai" (The Promise from Four Years Ago), and "Tsunagu Kizuna" (The Ties That Bind).

56150.description: Sakurai Ichiko is a 29-year-old woman whose head contains council members (each with differing personalities) that dictate her every thought and decision. While waiting at the train station one day, she encounters Saotome, a man whom she met and made short conversation with at a drinking party with friends. Although she’s interested in him, being a much a older woman, Ichiko hesitates over whether or not she should approach him, causing a wave of uproar between her intracranial council members.

56152.description: The demon king has awaken after his 500 years long slumber and he tries to destroy mankind. Now a little monk has to travel to look for 12 warriers with powers of the 12 chinese signs to fight him.

56156.description: With this revolutionary manga, later king of Japanese horror manga Kazuo Umezu pioneered the genre "Rabu-kome” (Romance Comedy) in shojo manga.

title.native: ロマンスの薬あげます！

56157.description:
20 million criminals from outer space—exiled entities—are hurtling toward Earth! Tsubaki Sadamitsu, a pure-hearted delinquent, dons Ponkotsu, a helmet-shaped companion unit designed to recover the exiled entities, and stylishly transforms into Hakaima!! The epic sci-fi battle saga begins here!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

56160.description: Tom and Miyako were raised in the same orphanage. From the moment they met, Miyako has been unable to repress the impulse to soil Tom's beautiful hands. Sadistically embracing Tom is the proof of profoundly sweet love. What awaits the two who wound each other and lick each other's wounds!? The hard Eros of madness and pure love! The forefront of forbidden SM!

56162.description:
"I never forgot about that day... The feelings that I locked up began to stir!"

(Source: Boys On Boys Love)

56164.description:
"I want to tie a bond with Chika-chan". The Ukon General Masanori-sama, and the Sakon General Kanechika-sama had been friends since they were little. Masanori-sama, who's unorthodox yet has a pretty face, always follows Kanechika-sama around in the imperial court. One night, just having had talks about his marriage come up, Masanori-sama sneaks into Kanechika-sama's room... for a night visit!?

Note: Fouth volume of the Isshoni Kuraso. Series. Also includes a sequel story for Chikakute Tooi.

56166.description: Ayata is a Magic School student with no talent in Magic. Not only were his parents exceptional with Magic but he has to contend with the scary-faced Kurefu Sensei. Just what is he to do? Luckily for him help is at hand with the return of a certain odd-looking cat and the appearance of a certain person. But what is their connection?
synonyms: Koi Suru Neko no Mahou Kyoushitsu

56168.description: Kitagawa gets confessed to by the popular, Yamamoto. Taking advantage of the situation, he accepts and they start going out. But, Kitagawa has a secret that he would die before letting Yamamoto know about... Can their relationship work out, or will the secret be exposed?!

56172.description:
Shuuji is a loser living a boring life. But one day...someone comes from the future and gives him a chance to stand in the spotlight!

(Source: Manga Reborn)

title.native: エンジェリック・ハウス

56173.description:
Kei-chan discovers something missing when he wakes up in the morning. A story about a world where high school students can swap genders everyday on a whim.

(Source: MU)

56174.description:
Himemiya, Suzukake, and Sakurai. These three people's personal history and circumstances are completely different but they are all students attending the same high school. After an unexpected accident these three start remembering memories from a past life. "The next time we are reborn, let us be happy like we were then..."

(Source: Silver Lining)

title.native: それならハートにきいてみろ!

56176.description: One night, Alice enters her master's bedroom to find him gone. After waiting 3 days with no word from him she finds a number for a detective agency. She later meets Chocola from the agency and together soon find their masters. This 4-koma revolves around the activities of these two girls and the detective agency, including artificial humans, vampire hunters, romcom and a bit of gender confusion.
synonyms: 2Chome Back of Alley Detective's Strange Story

title.native: 二丁目路地裏探偵奇譚

56177.description: A Moyoco Anno series that tackles the campy robot girl fighting for justice tropes with style.

56178.description:
In the eleventh year of the Meiji era carrying swords was forbidden by the government and those known as samurai were slowly fading away. However there were plenty that didn’t like those changes taking place in Japan and inevitably the crime rates increased. Japan’s only resolve was an inescapable lake prison. While the prison had no other way to access it but only through water, the 3 boys of the Kumo family were assigned to transport the criminals to their new "home". Although... is that the only thing they were doing...?

Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Utakata ni Warau (泡沫に笑う) - 2 chapters

56182.description:
Ukishima Shrine is located in an old, picturesque lakeside town. Shrine maiden Kisaragi Saya lives there along with her father, Tadayoshi. By day, she lives the life of a normal high school student at Sanbara Academy. By night, she hunts the Old Ones. Possessing supernatural physical prowess, the Old Ones prey on humans, and only Saya has the ability to defeat them.

(Source: AniDB)

56185.description:
It is the Meiji era. Yui is completely bewildered by her sudden transfer to Kaede Juku, a prestigious girls' school. At that time, Yuu, the daughter of a large enterprise, appears before Yui.
Yui and Yuu's friendship immediately deepens. Although it seems as if they will spend time together peacefully, Yuu appears to have a mysterious air about her somewhere...

56196.description:
A vast kingdom called Lucifenia, whose popular name was the "Kingdom of Yellow", was ruled by a tyrannical princess named Rillianne and she was still only fourteen years old. Under her absolute monarchism, everything was exploited from people and the ones who did not obey her were executed without mercy. Allen, a servant who looked like her, was always beside the princess who was called "Daughter of Evil" by the people. The princess's selfishness caused a war and many deaths, and thus the secret clockwork of fate was going to spin madly.

(Source: Wikipedia)

56198.description:
Little girls have gone missing. Among them is….
"Father, my little sister was kidnapped!”, cried Wilhelm.
The priests gives him hope, “Let’s pray for the Lord to drive the demon away”.
But Wilhelm believes that praying won’t change anything.
He would do anything to save his little sister….
Even if he has to pay with his soul in exchange.
He confronts the demon that lives in the outskirts of town.
“AREN’T YOU…”, Wilhelm openly suspects the creature, “THE ONE RESPONSIBLE?!”
…… the demon smiles maliciously.

(Source: The Zero Alliance)

56201.description:
High school student Koremitsu Akagi finds himself attending the funeral of Hikaru Mikado, who had died in an accident during Golden Week. He's not sure why he's there, as he only exchanged a few words with Hikaru at school.

However, Hikaru doesn't seem to be completely gone from the world, as he comes back as a ghost in order to fulfill a promise to Aoi Saotome, his fiancée. Since Koremitsu is the only one who can see him, he asks him to carry out his promise in his place.

Complying with his request, Koremitsu tries to fulfill Hikaru's promises to the rest of his "girlfriends", helping them overcome past misunderstandings and repair broken relationships. But the situation surrounding Hikaru's death is shrouded in mystery, as it's uncertain whether or not he truly died in an accident...
synonyms: When Hikaru was on the Earth......
แด่รักและความทรงจำของฮิคารุ

title.native: ヒカルが地球にいたころ......
title.romaji: Hikaru ga Chikyuu ni Ita koro......

56202.description: Heads that roll under the moon.

56203.description: This is the first out of three gaidens (side stories) that were released after Takahashi Hiroshi finished his famous delinquent manga Crows. It focuses on the pasts of the Ebizuka trio (Mako, Pon & Hiromi), Bandou Hideto and Bouya Harumichi in a total of 3 chapters. It takes place when all of them were still in middle school.

title.native: わがツン　わが家の長男ツンデレ社長
title.romaji: Waga Tsun: Waga Ie no Chounan Tsundere Shachou

56206.description:
It happened after school one rainy day... A group of friends have stayed behind to prepare for the next day’s school festival. One moment they are idly telling ghost stories but the next an enormous earthquake strikes and the entire school seems to fall down around them. They awake to find themselves trapped in a parallel version of their school. As school abandoned and disheveled and whose calendar dates back to 1927. Can they find a way out of this nightmare or are they doomed to the same fate that befell the other victims whose corpses that lie numerous throughout the school?

Note: Chapter counts contains an extra chapter and an origin chapter.

title.native: コープスパーティー娘

56209.description: Tateyama Sukai has just transferred into a high school filled with "princesses" from wealthy and influential families. In her search for club activites that appeal to her love of physical activity, she comes across a mountain climbing club, and finds herself drawn into the world steep ascents under the open sky.

56210.description: Having forgotten to hand in his science paper, Sera goes looking for his teacher in the staff room. Unfortunately for him, his teacher isn't alone when he finds him. He's with Sera's classmate Sasaoka, and to Sera's shock, the two of them appear to be lovers. Having secretly witnessed something he shouldn't have, the incident leaves Sera with confused feelings...

56211.description:
Higaki was looking for a one-night-stand in a gay bar and suddenly met his unrequited love, Souta. After sleeping together for a few times, Higaki told Souta to look for his true love. Actually, Souta was in love with his own twin elder brother. Unable to move on, Higaki wanted to end it with Souta. Yet an accident happened and changed the outcome of their relationship.

(Source: Mangatraders)

56214.description: The main character Daichi has conflicting feelings about relations between men.

56216.description:
Kasumi is a somewhat clumsy 14-year-old girl. Her best friend, Mariko, is deeply in unrequited love, and Kasumi also becomes interested in Kuzumi-kun, the person Mariko is secretly in love with. However, Kasumi holds in her heart the memory of a boy who gave her a "star fragment" when she was little.

... When will she be able to reunite with the person who gave her that precious memory?

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

56217.description:
Due to the friendship he had with Ted, McDohl's attempt to save him eventually turned his life around from being the son of General Teo McDohl of the Imperial Army to become a wanted enemy of the Empire. A chosen bearer of one of the 27 True Runes, his encounters with death were already foreboding the moment the True Rune was attached to his right hand. Yet, McDohl continues to walk upon the journey through the Empire: facing corruption, cruelty and the life-changing decisions he has to make in order to restore order and peace for the people in his country and to fulfill the hope of many that was entrusted to him.

Based on the PSOne video game, it is also loosely based on the Water Margin classics, though it's limited only to the gathering of 108 Stars of Destiny in order to overthrow a corrupt government.

title.native: 幻想水滸伝  - 受け継がれし紋章

56219.description:
A collection of short stories:

1. Friendly Fire by Yokoyama Mayumi
2. B・F Romance by Mitsuki Kako
3. Ookami-tachi no Shiikuhou by Shiiba Nana
4. 7 Days by Konno Risa
5. Mikkai Coffee Flavor by Motomi Kyousuke
6. Puchi no Koto by Mame Moyashi

56220.description: Yuu is a healthy high school student who harbors a crush for his Kyouko-sensei. He absolutely loves everything about her and after fretting about the subject for some time he decides to confess; to his surprise Kyouko-sensei is also in love with him and agrees to date him... The catch is that Yuu doesn't know why Sensei is in love with him, neither he knows her preferences when it comes to how to behave to her partner... And by the time of when Yuu learns this we have that "Yuumi" is born, now Yuu doesn't know if he should somehow enjoy his new relationship or regret it.

title.native: せんせい の ぼく

56221.description: Takeshi goes to the beach with his friends, but he's the only one who didn't bring a girlfriend! But he's in luck, as Yuu-chan, who's being ignored by her boyfriend decides to have some fun with Takeshi. It's only 8 pages, but in full color, and very well drawn!

56223.description: 4-page game comic to the original game by Saga Planets.

title.native: キサラギ-GOLD★STAR~Moonlight serenade in autumn

56224.description: The popular Shoujo mangaka, Yoshino Chiaki, got confessed by his editor in charge, Hatori Yoshiyuki, who is his childhood friend, they even ended up with more than that.  What will happen to Yoshino who swing between, love, friendship and work...? The fully loaded of know-how publishing industry of love, which turns editors to the extent of pale, unfolds on the stage of publishing company, Marukawashuten.
synonyms: Sekai Ichi Hatsukoi - Yoshino Chiaki no Baai
Sekai Ichi Hatsukoi - The Case of Yoshino Chiaki

title.native: 世界一初恋~吉野千秋の場合
title.romaji: Sekaiichi Hatsukoi: Yoshino Chiaki no Baai

synonyms: Every Man Has His Own Peculiar Habits

56227.description: High school friends reunited after graduation in a mixed bath.

56234.description:
Ooga Miko moves from the countryside to the city to look for her older sister. Soon after arriving, she spots a cat about to fall from a rooftop down into the street below. In saving the cat, she falls from the roof, but later wakes up to find that the cat from before has used one of its nine lives to repay its debt and return her to life! Unfortunately, a cat's life only accounts to a year of life for a human, so Miko must now solve 100 cases in order to regain a full life. A series of strange adventures with animals in human form ensues.

Note: Includes two bonus chapters

title.native: ぼくラはミンナ生きテイル!

56255.description:
Xiao Chiu dreams of becoming a great Chinese chef, always has the urge to cook food when she's in the kitchen, and cuts vegetables whenever she has a knife in her hands. Her passion for cooking was rewarded when she found a well-paying job - to be Lei's personal chef for a month. But Lei is arrogant, smokes, has a bad temper... and is very picky about food. He has a sensitive stomach and will throw up if something he ate does not agree with him. He also will not eat anything that doesn't suit his taste. What a hard-to-satisfy guy! Lei just happens to be her classmate, too! Poor Xiao Chiu! Even worse, after one month, having spent day and night together, they develop tangled feelings towards each other! Xiao Chiu feels confused. In seeing the one-month deadline approaching, she decides to run away. But, if she does not cook for him, Lei may get sick again... Xiao Chiu, what are you going to do?

(Source: Amazon)

56257.description:
High School student Natsumi gets "sold" to fill in her brother's debts. It turns out, the debt collector a student of her school, to whom she is both senior and student council member.

Notes:
- Includes the one shot "April Fish (エイプリル・フィッシュ)"; Deluxe Bessatsu Shoujo Comic 1995-05
- Includes the one shot "EYE'S (Aizu) (EYE・S（合図）)"; Bessatsu Shoujo Comic 1995-07
synonyms: Mizushiro Setona Kessakushuu 1: 100-man Dollar no Onna
エイプリル・フィッシュ
水城せとな傑作集1 100万ドルの女

56260.description:
One year after the events of Bloody Monday Season 2, a new terrorist is born and an unforeseen and impossible cyber crisis begins in this new act of terrorism.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.
synonyms: ブラッディ・マンデイラストシーズン

title.native: BLOODY MONDAY ラストシーズン

56261.description:
This is the story of Fujishima-sensei and her "adventures" in dealing with the Sexual Education Committee at her school...

(Source: BakaBT)
synonyms: Shin Dorei Onna Kyoushi Mashou no Curriculum
真・奴隷女教師魔性のカリキュラム

title.native: 奴隷女教師魔性のカリキュラム
title.romaji: Dorei Onna Kyoushi Mashou no Curriculum

56263.description:
Haruru Shirosaki, a girl whose father is a director, is always busy. Her best friend is Mami. She visits a girl's school across the road from a boy's school.

One day she sees a boy in the window of the boy's school. When she comes home from school the boy she had seen earlier is there saying he will become her butler? Is this just a dream?

56264.description: A short story by Rokuro Shinofusa about a "perfect family".

title.native: 篠房六郎短編集 こども生物兵器

56265.description:
1) Ao no Rhapsodia
There's a legend about a lost continent of gold and only one man has successfully made his way through the treacherous waters to that continent. The man entrusted the map to the lost continent to his daughter, Allegra Reese, making her the prime target for every pirate on Edythe Island.

2) Koushoku Kyousou Kyoku

3) Watashi no Sutekina Hito

4) Ousama Yuugi (Ousama Game)
Nene, a young assassin girl, has orders to kill king Ruu, so she goes undercover as his maid. But things are not always what they seem, and this seemingly stupid king has his own agenda. So the story begins, with Nene on her mission, while the perverted King is out to hit on her.

5) Natsu no Requiem

synonyms: It is living happily on ground everyday.

56268.description:
A classical favorite manga based on the book by Jin Yong. The story about Wai Siu Bo the boy who was brought up in the red light district and became the best friend of the emperor through lots of luck and a smart mouth.

(Source: Mangatraders)

title.native: あいらんど 淫悦の章

56272.description: Hifumi, a mail clerk in his hometown, adores the novelist Enichi. One day, he is given a rich kiss by Enichi who came to mess around and his body responds. Will Hifumi begin to pour out his feelings to Enichi which he has been covering up until now?

56275.description:
1. Oujisama ni Narenai
2. Magic Chip wa Uso wo Tsuku
3. Machi Kado Tissue
4. Home Sick Baby
5. Takeshima Bowling and Closing Preparations
synonyms: Magic Chip wa Uso wo Tsuku

56280.description: The story revolves around a highschool boy named Niwa Makoto. He lives with his aunt’s family since his parents are away on business. It is there where he meets his mysterious cousin of the same age Touwa Erio — who happens to tie a futon mattress around her upper body and is a self-proclaimed alien. Her staple food is pizza. Erio had been missing for half a year and was found floating in the sea. She doesn't remember anything about what happened during that period of time, but she began to think that it was the act of an alien and wanders the neighbourhood wrapped in the futon.
synonyms: Electromagnetic Wave Woman and Adolescent Man

56283.description:
There are three sisters in the Mikumagawa family: calm, relaxed college student Manaka, the quite rough-spoken (?) high-schooler Rinka, and the youngest Yuuka, a smart young girl who can recite the succession of shoguns in the bath. With a family like this, every day is a little adventure!

(Source: Manga Planet)

title.native: メロンくりーむソーダ

56285.description:
When he was young, Kurosu Keisuke was in a special TV program showcasing children with supernatural powers, called "Esper Shounen". Seven years after the termination of the program, a murderer appears to be targeting the Esper kids, who he/she considers to be monsters. Will Keisuke and his old friends be able to discover the murderer and avoid becoming the next victims?!

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title.native: ディー・シー・ディー

56287.description: Even after all these years, you’re still the only one I think of… I’ll put all of my feelings into this letter for you.

56288.description:
I’ll sing this song for you in the garden… so come and listen to the song while gazing at flowers.

(Source: Aerandria)

title.romaji: Hana to Watashi ni Ongaku wo

56289.description:
In the Mister Millionaire series:

V.1 - Kekkon no Kokoroe (Expecting the Boss's Baby)
"I love you, not as my boss but as a man." It had been 2 months since Kate spent a night of passion with her boss, Michael, whom she secretly loves. But the next day, Michael cruelly tells her that their relationship must strictly be kept to business. Kate cannot forget about that night, and tells Michael how she feels... In fact, Michael grew up in an orphanage. He had a difficult childhood and now finds it impossible to love. Can Kate's love change Michael?

V.2 - Kekkon nante Shitakunai (Millionaire Husband)
Justin, a genius of the stock trading business is a real scrooge despite being a millionaire. He believes marriage only drains your bank account, and only contributes to charity to evade taxes. While investigating a charity, he meets a poor but charming girl named Amy. However their encounter is cut short when he suddenly coughs up blood and collapses. Amy rushes him to the hospital and while drifting between the borders of life and death, he had a dream: his friends standing at his bed side, sadly mumbling "he only thought of money, money, money", "he never learnt to love anyone". Justin is suddenly swamped with a feeling of deep regret. He prays to God, "please, just give me another chance!"

V.3 - Anata no Kioku
Alisa has always been with Dylan for as long as she can remember: she gave him her first kiss as a teenager and, later, her virginity. But when Alisa finds Dylan bedding another woman, his cruel betrayal devastates her and she brings a sad end to their long-term relationship. At her worst, an accident befalls her. When Alisa wakes up, she has lost every bit of memory related to Dylan! This is the final story of a high-profile miniseries, Million-Dollar Men, which depicts the romances of self-made millionaires.

56290.description:
Clarissa is a daughter of an aristocrat, but after losing her parents at a young age, she spent a lonely childhood in boarding schools. And now, even her guardian uncle is gravely ill. If her uncle was to pass away, according to law she would lose all of her inheritance. To prevent this, she must marry, but her unpleasant, gold-digging cousin will not leave her alone. She decides to devise a plan and offers a proposition to a bankrupt 2nd son of an Earl; "Elope with me in return for my ￡10,000 inheritance!"

(Source: Renta!)

56291.description: Haruka was always weak as a child, unable to normally attend school. Nevertheless, he dreamed of going to school as a regular person, and his wish finally came true. As a result, he is a rare specimen, innocent in the ways of the world, giving him the nickname of "Prince". Follow him in his new school life as he makes friends and befriends one friend, Ryouhei, a little more specially. This is a cute, innocent story.

title.native: うちの王子いりませんか

56292.description:
The story follows a girl in the "Threshold" (狭間, Hazama), a world beween Heaven and Earth. "Impure souls"—those that could not ascend to Heaven with the burden of their own weight—have drifted to this world of constant warfare.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: ブラック★ロックシューター -イノセントソウル-

56296.description: In the fifth unit of the special police bureau lies a group of special individuals known as the “SAKURA”. Formed for the purpose of carrying out secret missions, they gave up their nationality, erased their past and concealed their real identities. There will be no salvation for the “SAKURA” who failed in his mission, except for their one and only “Messiah” – the only existence that can pull them back from the path of death…

56298.description:
2010 was a big year for Mizuki Shigeru as it was the year of his 88th birthday and also a year that saw a mini-revival of interest in his life.

This short Manga tells the story of 2010 through Mizuki's eyes and what it meant to him from the sudden boom in popularity surrounding Gegege no Nyobo to him receiving the order of the Golden Sun from the Emperor in recognition of his life-long contributions to Japanese culture.

56299.description:
Set a short while before the end of the original rental book version of the story, this charming tale tells of a mysterious string of disappearances throughout the village.

Many of the school children appear to go missing without explanation and it's not until Kanpei stumbles across an eerie earthenware pot lying in the grass on his way home that he discovers the true whereabouts of his fellow villagers.

This extremely rare manga is one of 4 chapters that are long out of print and incredibly difficult to get hold of. The other 3 chapters (or gaiden) are: 木神さま(Kikami-sama), 幽霊の手(Yuurei no te), and 夢のハム工場 (Yume no Ham Koujou).

title.native: 河童の三平外伝：ふしぎな甕
title.romaji: Kappa no Sanpei Gaiden: Fushigina Kame

56300.description:
Sara Kinsale is stunned to be thrown together with a prince of the desert, and even more so to find herself unbelievably attracted to the elusive Sheikh Kahrun bak Samin.... Especially as she's indebted to the sheikh and it's only a matter of time before he demands to be repaid!

Kahrun soon names his price -- marriage! He needs a trophy wife, and Sara is already living under his roof. But will she be the sheikh's bride in name only -- or will her marriage duties be a little more intimate...?

56301.description: New shinigami Hikari is doing her best every day to get used to her onerous duties. The only thing that keeps her going is the kindness of her superior, Commander Ryouma. But, when a disastrous event happens among the shinigami, everything changes...

56303.description: A girl gives a “graduation gift” to her beloved senior.

56304.description: A guy gets help with his entrance exam from his childhood friend. Will she be of any help in the end?

56305.description: Megumi finds it discomforting being around boys yet on their class trip, she's assigned to sit next to Taketo-kun. After a small incident, they become friends, will romance bloom next?

title.native: 修学旅行★ナイショの恋

56307.description: This is a adaptation on the of the fable of  hardworking ant and the playful grasshopper.  This story is a human persona  which is reflected in the two main characters. Follow the twist of this fable through their daily lives.

56308.description: Unknown to humans, a separate world, populated with supernatural creatures exists beside the world of humans. Some people of that world live secretly among humans, for various reasons. This manga is about four teenage boys, Minami, Shiro, Tohru, and Takaya, who all have links to the supernatural world. They pretend to live as ordinary humans, but they work part time to help solve the supernatural incidents in the human world!

title.native: ハロウィン+タウン－Party time－

56309.description:
1. Heart wa Junbichuu♥ (ハートは準備中♥, Ready To Love)
2. Kataomoi (カタオモイ, Weight For Me)
3. Ikunen Kurunen (イク年 クル年, a happy new century)
4. Virgin White (ヴァージンホワイト)
5. Sakura no Mori (桜の杜, Graduation)
6. Tokyo Maid Gakuen (東京マイド学園, Made Me a Maid)
7. S.O.S (Sweet Own Sister)
8. Chijou no Mermaid (地上の人魚姫〈マーメイド〉, Mermaid the Hammer)
9. Kango shichau zo♥ (看護しちゃうぞ♥, Let Me Heal You)

56311.description: Sanae-chan is so thrilled: today is field day at their school and everyone will be out doing P.E. That means she and her beloved Shin-chan can have sex inside the school building! She drags the protesting Shin-chan along--but it looks like everyone else had the same idea. Locker rooms: "Ooh-ahh!" Nurse's Office: "Unh! Unh!" Music Room: "Slurp-slurp!" Sanae-chan is ready to howl with frustration. But there's one place left they didn't think of...

56315.description: A wife gets a call from her husband, claims, that she has a friend for dinner, hangs up and... proceeds to have passionate sex with this "friend", who is actually a student and lover of hers.

title.native: ホット・ティーチャー

56316.description: An old friend from the childhood helps a girl to embrace her femininity.

56317.description:
A bicurious girl joins a club for "girls who like girls."

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime Spring 2009 issue.

56322.description:
Collection of adult comedy short stories.

1. Pex Banzai
2. Women Howling at the Moon
3. Kurushimasu Eve / Christmas Eve
4. No Deposit!
5. The Moron Corporation
6. The Idiot's Guide to: Sex Fortune-Telling
7. A Beggarly Nobleman
8. Men and Their Toys
9. Weird Tastes
10. Fuusuke: A History Of
11. Foxes

56324.description:
Shy Nakaba has been a shut-in ever since gossip at school destroyed his reputation. But when his mom snags him a job to help him break out of his shell, he’s forced to face a co-worker who knows a thing or two about courage and commitment! Can Nakaba stand tall and speak up for what he truly wants? Mr. Mini Mart serves up a sweet-and-salty story filled with brave confessions and bold crushes! Will the past catch up to a boy who wants nothing more than to hide away forever? Or will the future finally shine with the promise of brand-new beginnings?

(Source: Juné)

Included one-shot: Shounen Scrub (Youthful Love)

56325.description:
1) Soko wa Chuumon no Ooi Ryouriten (そこは注文の多い料理店, The Restaurant of Many Orders)
A young woman frequents a certain French bistro. She would really enjoy the food they serve if only it weren't for the bossy chef owner. "You may not like me, but I love your food."

2) Toumei Ningen no Koi (透明人間の恋, Invisible Girl in Love)
A girl, mocked by a classmate, decides to take more care of her appearance.

3) Matryoshka (マトリョーシカ)
As each doll is opened up to give another one, so does each memory containing his feelings towards her.

4) Kattena Futari (勝手な2人, The Selfish Couple)

5) drops. (ドロップス。)
A series of interconnected vignettes depicting how something as ordinary as rain can alter the course of people's lives.

56330.description: Dahlia is the only female dressmaker in Galleria. She kidnapped and commissioned by the infamous "Honeybee Earl", who is known to jump from woman to woman like a capricious bee jumps from flower to flower, to make the ultimate wedding dress for his fiancee. Can Dahlia complete the dress without getting stung by the Honeybee Earl?
synonyms: The Honeybee Earl and the Flower Dress

title.native: 蜜蜂伯爵と花のドレス
title.romaji: Mitsubachi Hakushaku to Hana no Dress

56332.description: A collection of 8 one-shot stories. Extreme stuff like all the rest.

title.native: サーチ&悶絶デストロイ

56334.description: Yurina has set aside her painful memories of being bullied by Takaya, and accepted his sincerity. They're now dating and slowly rediscovering themselves, but their kindergarten classmate Nogi dredges up their past and vows to "rescue" Yurina from Takaya's evil clutches. Will Takaya and Yurina's love — a love that started off on a bad footing — withstand new trials, growing uncertainty and revisits to the past?

56344.description: One of the firsts Yuu Kinutani stories. A girl named Tika, that has a great, mysterious, power is involved in the cruel battle for egemony between 3 great kingdoms.

56349.description: The members of the fish paste club include Arisugawa Sakura, the school's number one trap, Aoi sensei, their club advisor and a beautiful trap himself, and Kurumi, their youngest member. Thanks to Sakura's appeal, Kurumi gets pulled into the strange, sexual world of the fish paste club, but will he be able to win Sakura's heart away from his childhood friend?

56360.description: A side-story of Benio and Papa Usaki that occurs after the main storyline.

title.native: PINK 番外編 スイッチ

56363.description: A Sakende Yaruze/Shout Out Loud sidestory. Tenryuu's life is turned upside down when he has to take care of his giddy 10-year-old daughter, Mari. Mari is excited about the arrival of a new baby half-brother, but is worried about her father being on his own. Tenryuu is exasperated by Mari's picky eating habits, fickle moods and incessant questions about making a baby. Can father and daughter ever see eye to eye?

56364.description:
Collection of two stories:

1. Mafuyu no Secret (真冬のシークレット)
Police officer Ahane is exasperated when he is assigned to guard Prince Laronne, a young exiled prince who has no regard for his own safety. However, his frustration turns to horror when he discovers the infatuated prince is more interested in using him as a personal escort!

2. Akatsuki ni Naku, Kaze ni Naku Choral (暁に哭く、風に鳴くコラール)
Jim heads west across the wilderness in search of his missing best friend, Dennis. However, a man named Smith appears before him and claims that Dennis has been taken away by a vampire...?

3. Extra

title.native: 暁に哭く、風に鳴くコラール
title.romaji: Akatsuki ni Naku, Kaze ni Naku Choral
Wakareru Futari no Ai no Gekijou

56370.description: Before…magic used to fill up the world but all of a sudden it just disappeared. Magician can’t perform magic anymore and they are now being looked down by warriors. Only two individuals in the world are able to perform magic after its disappearance, a mighty wizard and a little boy… Follow Melrose and his companions in their adventures as they are trying to solve this mystery!

56372.description:
"The theme of this book is unconditional love. It is a light-hearted look weaving the day-to-day events of the heroine, a sixteen-year-old girl named Sana, and the family, friends and pet dog who make up her world. In the midst of this lurks a number of factors causing Sana to feel insecure, and leading her to search for a way to calm her feelings of anxiety and nervousness."

Excerpt from Japanese Writers House website. Copyright(c) 2007 Shinbunka all rights reserved.

56373.description: Dragon Ball: Episode of Bardock is a three-chapter manga created by Ooishi Naho and based on the video game Dragon Ball Heroes. It features a spin-off scenario taking place after the events of the TV special Dragon Ball Z: Bardock - The Father of Goku, in which Bardock survives after his confrontation against Freeza and turns into a Super Saiyan.

title.native: ドラゴンボール エピソード オフ バーダック

56375.description: High school girl Suzuki Mirai loses consciousness from getting involved in a road traffic accident. She wakes up in a world 400 years later, where the dragons rule. Having received the dragon Aira's heart for a transplant, Mirai has to live as a Dragon-Person.

56377.description:
A young girl has to take the place of a partner who passed away.

Note: Published in Tsubomi vol. 1 & 2.

56378.description:
A long oneshot and two additional one shot stories:

Ame no Furu Nichi ni

Mugen Heartbeat / Limitless Heartbeat
Orina helps a cute alien from Planet Manii to get home using the power of her secret love for her classmate.

A collection of cute oneshots:

-Sakura Shoku Yōgashi Mise
-Kan Shoku Bokkusu
-Mahō Tsukai Okotowari

(Source: Rebellious Love)

56385.description: When a girl passes by her classmate in a corridor, she notices a sweet fragrance she's never smelled before. She asks the other girl about her shampoo but still can't find the scent's origin. Just where did it come from?

56386.description:
It is said that once every 10,000 years, a child capable of reading and understanding the ancient Jewish scriptures for Demon resurrection, will be born into the world. The last person to come close to achieving such a feat was the great Professor Faust who, through sheer will-power alone has managed to live for 300 years in anticipation of the advent of the next "chosen one" so that he can impart his knowledge directly before he can die.

That child is Shingo Yamada, A.K.A: Akuma-kun. Shingo is a boy genius living in Japan who, with the help of his close friends, is attempting to solve the riddle of Demon resurrection so that he can use the tremendous power of the Demons to unite the world as one nation where everyone can live as equals and in total harmony with each other.

Shingo's efforts are effectively fruitless until he encounters Professor Faust. Upon receiving Faust's assistance, he is able to resurrect a demon called Mephisto and is able to control him by using the magical Solomon flute that was entrusted to him by Faust before he died.
Before long however, Shingo finds himself a target for powerful wizards that are hell-bent on procuring the powerful Solomon's flute for their own evil intents. Thus begins the many trials of Akuma-kun and Mephisto as they work together to protect the world from some of the most frightening demons the world has ever seen!

Written 2 years after the end of the Original Akuma-kun rental comic book, Shigeru Mizuki revisits his characters and changes the entire theme of the story. In this version, Akuma-kun's name has been changed from Ichiro Matsushita to Shingo Yamada in order to tie-in with the black and white television drama that aired on Japanese T.V at the same time as publication. In this version, Akuma-kun is a kindhearted boy that seeks to defeat evil demons and Yokai with the help of his reluctant friend, Mephisto, for the better good of society.

56391.description:
A historical story set during the early Edo period focusing on young samurai Rintarou Nakatani and his friends.

(Source: Comic Natalie)

56394.description: The Samurai Troopers are five warriors who were given magic armor and must use it to defeat Arago and his warlords.

title.native: 鎧伝サムライトルーパー

56396.description: Shigeru Yakumo, talent scout and model manager of cactus productions works with lovely, big-breasted ladies on a daily basis. As if that wasn't lucky enough, he comes home to his loving, sex-crazed wife, Nanaho, who used to be the top model of cactus productions! Working with beauties starts to take a toll on Shigeru when temptation strikes and the models come after him! Can shigeru resist these alluring vixens and stay true to his wife? Or will he fall into breast temptation? Lovely ladies, happy sex, and a rom-com story with heart as big as their breasts, breast temptation will surely leave you panting for more.

synonyms: His Final Move Hit My Weak Spot

title.romaji: Kareshi no Hissatsu Waza ga Itai kara

56402.description:
Living alone in the Colorado Rockies, U.S. Marshal Dan Mason didn't want company. Still, Dan can't resist a damsel in distress, especially when a hiking accident lands violet-eyed Angel on his doorstep. Angel has lost her memory and her identity, but at least now she has shelter and hope.

(Source: Harlequin)

56404.description:
"Live with Sincerity" is Natsuki Taiyou's motto. It's first day of high school and Taiyou was heading to a school and Taiyou meets Hinata during the way there. He fell in love at first sight and suddenly confessed to her. Her answer was yes and she runs away without saying who she was, but it turns that she was her classmate. Taiyou felt a destiny between them. However, on the next day, she doesn't remember who he is. why could it that be...?

(Source: jCafe24)

56412.description:
On the countryside, Shino was living in peace until the day she met Kento, a boy coming from Tokyo.

Black hair, glasses and smart, that boy is maybe unsociable but he’s nice and Shino can’t stop her heart beating so fast when she’s with him…that’s the beginning of their love…

(Source: Chibi Manga)

56413.description:
Lost memories. Polluted surface world. Superhuman powers. Unrelenting fighting spirit.

Udk’s first original doujinshi!

56415.description: A Japanese fifth grade elementary school student is shocked when he learns about street children in other countries like the the Phillipines, Vietnam, and Afghanistan.

1. Sekkusu Gokko (Playing Sex)

2. Shimai Don! (Sisters Bang!)
Mika asks Yukata-kun to her house to help her study. When Mika's older sister accidentally spills juice over Yukata, fun in the bath follows.

3. Deruderu Model (Up and Coming Model)

4. Boku wa Otoko no Musume. (I'm a Trap)
Young woman finds a girl on the bus, wearing almost nothing and looking ill. Concerned, she helps the girl off the bus to tend to her--and discovers the "girl" is actually a guy. This boy loves to cross-dress and then exhibit himself. Our young heroine is captivated by this very cute boy and offers to help clean him off after the mess he made...

5. Koori no Shojo (The Ice Maiden)
Akio finds out his lover interest the "ice maiden" isn't what she appears to be.

6. Sotsugyou Shichae!! (Graduate!!)
Yoshiki graduates from Middle school and from being a virgin.

56426.description: Ao Sakabara is a rising young actor who loves his fans. He credits his success to them. So he is thrilled when he gets a huge role in a drama written by his favorite screen writer! To top it off one of his co-actors is the biggest star of his agency. Life is good until an unexpected part of his past shows up to ruin everything.

title.native: シンデレラ プロット

56429.description: The innocent and beautiful priest Sera secretly loves his good friend, who will be married soon, even though he devoted himself to God. One stormy night Jin, a vampire in black, makes his appearance, as if he feels drawn towards this impure and polluted blood... With sweet words he seduces Sera into sin, but what is he really driving at?
synonyms: The Father is the Vampire's Bride

56430.description:
Studying at the same university, Tomiura and Shirosaki find about each other that they're gay thanks to a certain incident.
Attracted to each other by unknown power, they're charmed and start meeting each other more often, and prefer each other's company to other activities, but....?

Also includes stories: Kotonoha, Red Line.

A compilation of horror (guro) oneshots based on events, legends and folklore of the Middle Ages.

A slightly more gruesome take on the legend of Elizabeth Bathory, including torture, lesbian orgies and ritualistic defloration.

WARNING: Guro, rape, death, bloodplay, orgy

Names of chapters: 1. Executioner 2. Interrogation Room 3. The Wolves's Feast 4-5. Greedy Devourer 6. Chateau Rouge 7. Portrait of a Mirrage 8. End of an Endless Journey 9. Invaders 10. Memento Mori: Black Penance 11. Inside the Bird Cage 12. Captivity of a Holy Woman

56437.description:
1. Aroma Blend
A sadistic boss has feelings for both her employee and his coffee.

2. Sakura to Sake to Koigokoro (Cherry Blossoms & Sake & Love)

Makoto visits Yuuki in the hospital every day to keep him company, but what happens when one day she catches him masturbating?

A young man named Kazushi finds a soaked girl named Tama who's living in the streets, and takes her under his wing.

8. Love Lariat

56438.description:
I Will Go to School:
The guy's in high school and that's generally the cut-off, age wise...right? Well, the teacher has loli-teacher syndrome, so I guess it kinda cancels out.

It's Not Like We're Going Out, But...:
Kirihara's boyfriend wants to keep a secret that they're going out, so from now on no mater what happens, she says "We are not going out".
synonyms: It's Not Like We're Going Out

56441.description: After a long and treacherous journey, our Hero finally arrives at the Dark Lady’s castle only to find himself being asked for help. The Hero explains how the war that the demons have brought upon the humans have killed thousands and put more in misery. The queen of demons however argues that this war has made the human society band together as one and showed empirical evidence how it has increased population, increased production, boosted economy and improved society overall. Furthermore, she explains to the Hero that ending this war will result in a civil war that will produce more bloodshed than there ever was. The Hero, convinced that the only way to bring peace, relatively speaking, is to join forces with the Dark Lady, agrees to help with her plans!

title.english: MAOYU: Archenemy and Hero "Be Mine, Hero!" "I Refuse!"
title.native: まおゆう魔王勇者「この我のものとなれ、勇者よ」「断る!」
title.romaji: Maoyuu Maou Yuusha: 'Kono Watashi no Mono Tonare, Yuusha yo' 'Kotowaru!'

56446.description:
Omaezaki Sanemichi was born into a near-perfect existence. His family is wealthy and powerful, and he's good-natured, smart, and athletic as well! All the girls at his high school dream of having a Cinderella-style romance with him, and, though they are desperately jealous of him, none of the boys can come up with a legitimate reason to publicly hate him.

But one day the unthinkable happens: Sanemichi's family's flagship company collapses, and his father flees. Sanemichi and his former servants, the teenage siblings Natsuno and Asasuzu and the absent-minded old man Furukawa, are left without a dime. Will Sanemichi be able to maintain his gentlemanly behavior despite the humiliation and many hardships that face him?

(Source: MangaHelpers)

56448.description:
Welcome to Otokita Manor, a haven for several manga artists! Its residents include Hana Fujimori, an 18-year-old up-and-coming manga artist who spends her limitless energy on everything except actually making manga; Kanoko Imamura, Hana's roommate of the same age who supports her but wishes she was more responsible; Moe Kitayama, an aggressive and easily frightened manga artist of poor skill; and Tamaki Nishikawa, a relatively older and more experienced artist who advises Hana while also occasionally joining in her tomfoolery.

Mangaranai. follows the daily life of these four girls—parties and hijinks included. But amidst the fun, will Hana ever start making manga?

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

56452.description:
Kieron made a name for himself in the newspaper world through a scoop?and Beth's life, which he'd used to get the scoop, changed for the worse. What made things even harder was that she was now pregnant with his baby. Three years have passed, and Beth's changed her name and is starting a new job. Little does she know that her new boss at the Daily Globe is none other than Kieron?

(Source: Harlequin)

56459.description:
"With my beloved boyfriend I want to do that and this..." Every girl who's fallen in love before will nod because they're full of "No-Good Fantasies"! This should fill your maidens' hearts for sure!
